title: Ready Kids | Ready.gov
text:
Official websites use .gov
A .gov website belongs to an official government organization in the United States.
Secure .gov websites use HTTPS
A lock (
) or https:// means you’ve safely connected to the .gov website. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites.
Let's Make a Plan
What will your family do if disaster strikes? Make a plan today.
Disasters can happen anywhere, and everyone in the family can help prepare.
Whether you’re a kid, teen, parent, loved one, or someone who work with youth, Ready Kids has tools and information to help prepare for before, during and after disasters.
